name: CA-44
label: Safe D

key_factors: District leans about 20 points Democratic at the fundamentals level
Barragán holds a massive money edge: $1.09M on hand versus under $9k for Angel
Incumbent Barragán advanced to the general as expected
Prediction markets price Democratic win odds near 97%
model.rationale: The seat's deep Democratic lean, Barragán's overwhelming financial advantage, and markets pricing her near 97% all point to an easy incumbent hold; the challenger's negligible fundraising leaves no visible path to competitiveness.
model.watch: Any late-breaking scandal involving Barragán or a surge of outside spending for Angel could narrow the margin, though flipping this seat would still require an extraordinary shift.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.

overview:
CA-44 is a heavily Democratic Los Angeles County seat where incumbent Nanette Barragán is seeking another term. The district's partisan lean of roughly twenty points Democratic forms the foundation of the race, and Barragán advanced to the general election as expected. Republican Genevieve Angel enters as a little-known challenger with no evident source of strength in the seat.

The financial picture is starkly one-sided: Barragán has raised about $786,000 and holds more than $1 million on hand, while Angel has raised under $14,000. Prediction markets put Democratic win odds near 97 percent. With no public general-election polling and no expert ratings available, the forecast rests on district fundamentals, which point to a comfortable double-digit Democratic victory and a Safe D rating.
